title: STEP File Analyzer and Viewer
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
scope: General distinction between STEP geometry, semantic PMI, graphic PMI, and syntax checks. Does not assess or approve the AgentCADCAM fixture.
claims: Semantic PMI can represent computer-interpretable dimensional and geometric tolerances and datum features.
Graphic PMI describes annotation appearance and is distinct from semantic representation.
STEP syntax checks and PMI analysis are distinct checks; NIST lists AP214 Automotive Design separately from AP242.
